Featured project

GRADUATION PROJECT

Masar

Masar is a project and team management platform built to keep teams organized, aligned and productive, with full support for Arabic and English. I worked on it as part of my graduation project team, contributing to feature development, testing and database integration from first sketch to final delivery.

  • Sign-in A simple, secure way into your workspace.
  • Manager dashboard One view of projects, tasks and team performance.
  • Project tracking Status, priority and progress at a glance.
  • Task management To Do, In Progress, Done and Overdue, with priority levels.
  • Team & user management Add, edit and remove members with full role control.
  • AI assistant Builds teams, creates tasks and invites members through chat.
